text.tspan: Mean income per day within each decile (after tax), 1963 to 2024
The mean income per person per day within each decile (tenth of the population). Income here is measured after
taxes and benefits. This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.

Note: This data is expressed in
international-$
at 2021 prices. Income has been
equivalized
.
